description: The chats people sent to the brand’s LINE Official Account, and its answers. With no argument: every conversation from the last 7 days, newest first, each with who wrote, the last thing they said and whether the brand has answered. With conversationId: that whole conversation, oldest first, with a link to any photo, video, voice message or file the person sent. WHY ONLY 7 DAYS: LINE cannot return a message again after delivering it, so Hermoso keeps what arrives for 7 days and then deletes it, files included. TO REPLY: pass conversationId and reply. Inside a minute of the person’s message it goes as a free reply; after that it is a push message, which uses one message of the account’s monthly LINE quota (line_quota). A person who removed or blocked the account is refused, because LINE would accept the message and deliver nothing. A reply reaches a real person: show the user the exact words and get a yes first. 1:1 chats only, no group chats. Free, 0 credits. Needs LINE connected (Connectors > LINE, or connect_connector).

conversationId.description: one conversation’s id from this tool or from list_inbox (the part after "line:"): the LINE account id and the person, joined by |

reply.description: send this text as the reply to conversationId; the user must have approved the exact words
